baseline: Typed extraction plus all reported entity/period/unit/dimension bindings, primary-statement row labels, table heading and comparative-column structure. Inspect official DTS mappings if already available; absent mappings are recorded, never inferred by stripping taxonomy dates.
closure: Inspect the whole selected primary statement and all same-concept/same-period fully resolved candidates in each document. Every candidate and exclusion remains externally reproducible. A literal two-source reporting question can preserve distinct qualified concepts without asserting cross-taxonomy semantic identity. Any stronger semantic-equivalence claim remains unresolved without additional evidence.
fallback: If the primary statement has no unambiguous total-revenue row, retain the question and mark unresolved; do not substitute another measure or history.
next_decision: Only a genuine unresolved natural question after the competent baseline can motivate a text/table residual track. If these questions resolve, report no observed residual rather than manufacture difficulty.
primary_measure: consolidated total revenue in the primary income/operations statement
question_template: For fiscal year {earlier_document_fiscal_year}, what consolidated total revenue is displayed in the primary income/operations statement in each of these two annual filings? Preserve both source versions, source row labels, reported units and period. Are these two displayed amounts identical? Do not infer a restatement, correction or an economically equivalent measure from a difference.
raw_source_policy: Raw source and full extraction caches outside Git. Public artifacts only metadata, derived numeric facts, bounded short labels, digests and byte locators.
reference_provenance: Questions are protocol/template authored; references are program-extracted and agent source-reviewed development references, not independent human gold. No model prediction or QA inference call.
scope: The twelve previously exposed filings remain development. This six-history audit is not a prevalence estimate, reader test, held-out result, or retrieval comparison.
selection: Exactly one primary question per history. The earlier document fiscal year fixes the shared reporting period. Never substitute a period based on observed differences. Candidate generation may use revenue-like concept local names and row labels; local-name equality is not an admitted namespace bridge.
